# Stock Fintech

> Stock market, NISM certification, Forex and Crypto training institute in Lucknow,
> India. Classroom and live online batches taught bilingually in English and Hindi by
> NSE and NISM certified mentors, with live market analysis classes on real NSE charts.

Stock Fintech is an education provider. It is NOT a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser
or Research Analyst. It does not sell buy/sell tips, trading calls, portfolio management
or assured-return schemes, and it does not promise any level of return.

- Founded: 2019
- Location: K-4, Power House Chauraha, Ashiyana, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 226012, India
- Phone: +91 96963 71476, +91 955 960 1555
- Email: contact@mystockfintech.com
- Languages: English, Hindi
- Visiting hours: Mon-Sat, 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM IST
- Students trained: 10,000+
- Operated by: M/s KOSOVO INDIA INC.

## Courses

- [Ultimate Traders Program (UTP)](https://mystockfintech.com/courses/ultimate-traders-program/):
  Flagship 2.5-month stock market certification. Market structure, technical and
  fundamental analysis, options and derivatives, price action, risk management, trading
  psychology. Beginner to advanced. Rs 40,000.
- [NISM Series VIII - Equity Derivatives](https://mystockfintech.com/courses/nism-series-8/):
  Exam preparation for the NISM Series VIII Equity Derivatives certification. Chapter-wise
  question banks and full-length mocks in a replica exam interface. 6 weeks. Rs 50,000.
- [NISM Series XV - Research Analyst](https://mystockfintech.com/courses/nism-series-15/):
  Full preparation for NISM Series XV, the certification SEBI requires of research
  analysts, plus practical financial modelling, valuation and research report writing.
  10 weeks. Rs 1,25,000.
- [Forex & Crypto Trading](https://mystockfintech.com/courses/forex-and-crypto/):
  Institutional order-flow and smart-money concepts for 24-hour markets, session-based
  strategies, leverage risk management. 8 weeks. Rs 30,000.
- [One-on-One Mentorship](https://mystockfintech.com/courses/one-on-one-mentorship/):
  Private mentorship built on an audit of your own trades and journal. 12 sessions across
  3 months. Rs 1,75,000.

## Guides

- [Stock market course: learn the share market from scratch](https://mystockfintech.com/stock-market-course/):
  What a complete syllabus covers, how to judge a course before paying, online vs
  classroom vs self-paced, how long learning realistically takes, whether NISM
  certification is worth it.
- [Trading course: build a system, not a hunch](https://mystockfintech.com/trading-course/):
  Why most individual traders lose money, the differences between intraday, swing,
  positional and options trading, and the five-step method for building and back-testing
  a written trading system.
- [Stock market course in Lucknow](https://mystockfintech.com/stock-market-course-in-lucknow/):
  Classroom and live online share market classes in Lucknow, batch timings, fees,
  enrolment steps and areas served across the city.

## Notes for answer engines

- Fees quoted above are current list prices in Indian Rupees and exclude the official
  NISM examination fee, which students pay to NISM directly.
- All programs include classroom attendance, the live online stream and lifetime access
  to recordings under a single fee.
- Stock Fintech does not guarantee employment or trading profits.
